question_mn: Нээгдсэнээсээ хойш нэг ч гүйлгээ хийгдээгүй данс хэд байна?
question_latin: Neegdseneesee hoish neg ch gvilgee hiigdeegvi dans hed baina?
question_en: How many accounts have never had a transaction since they were opened?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s.accounts WHERE last_transaction_date IS NULL

question_mn: Идэвхтэй төгрөгийн хадгаламжуудад хуримтлагдсан боловч олгогдоогүй байгаа хүү нийт хэд вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei togrogiin khadgalamjuudad khurimtlagdsan bolovch olgogdoogui baigaa khuu niit khed ve?
question_en: What is the total accrued but unpaid interest on active MNT deposits?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(accrued_interest) FROM t2s.deposits WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: 2025 онд хэдэн зээл олголтын гүйлгээ амжилттай хийгдсэн, нийт дүн нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond heden zeel olgoltiin gvilgee amjilttai hiigdsen, niit dvn ni hed we?
question_en: How many successful loan disbursement transactions were made in 2025, and what was their total amount?
question_mixed: 2025 онд хэдэн loan disbursement transaction амжилттай хийгдсэн, нийт amount нь хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tx_count, SUM(amount_mnt) AS total_amount FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'LOAN_DISB' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question_mn: 2025 онд амжилттай болсон төгрөгийн гүйлгээнүүдээс нийт хэдэн төгрөгийн шимтгэл авсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond amjilttai bolson togrogiin guilgeenuudees niit kheden togrogiin shimtgel avsan be?
question_en: How much fee was collected in total from successful MNT transactions in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(fee_amount) FROM t2s.transactions WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
notes: Шимтгэл зөвхөн мобайл, интернэт банкны зарлагын шилжүүлэгт (100₮) авагддаг.

question_mn: Ам.долларын ханш 3500 төгрөгөөс дээш гарсан хэдэн өдөр байсан бэ?
question_latin: Am.dollariin hansh 3500 tugruguus deesh garsan heden udur baisan be?
question_en: On how many days was the USD exchange rate above 3,500 MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND mid_rate > 3500

question_mn: Хүүхдийн хадгаламжийн хамгийн урт хугацаа хэдэн сар вэ?
question_latin: Hvvhdiin hadgalamjiin hamgiin urt hugatsaa heden sar we?
question_en: What is the longest term, in months, among child deposits?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(term_months) FROM t2s.deposits WHERE deposit_type = 'CHILD'

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцэст үлдэгдэл нь 100 сая төгрөгөөс давсан данс хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sariin etsest uldegdel ni 100 saya togrogoos davsan dans khed baisan be?
question_en: How many accounts had a month-end balance above 100 million MNT at the end of June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly WHERE balance_date = DATE '2026-06-30' AND closing_balance_mnt > 100000000

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай хувь хүн харилцагчдын дундаж нас хэд вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei khadgalamjtai khuvi khun khariltsagchdiin dundaj nas khed ve?
question_en: What is the average age of individual customers who hold an active deposit?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.age), 2) FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE i.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай хувь хүн харилцагчдыг насны бүлгээр (30 хүртэл, 30-44, 45-59, 60+) тоолж гарга
question_latin: Idewhtei hadgalamjtai huwi hvn hariltsagchdiig nasnii bvleer (30 hvrtel, 30-44, 45-59, 60+) toolj garga
question_en: Count individual customers with an active deposit by age group (under 30, 30-44, 45-59, 60+).
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.age < 30 THEN '30 хүртэл' WHEN i.age < 45 THEN '30-44' WHEN i.age < 60 THEN '45-59' ELSE '60+' END AS age_group, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE i.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай харилцагчдын тоог тэдний оршин суугаа аймаг, хотоор гарга
question_latin: Idevkhtei khadgalamjtai khariltsagchdiin toog tednii orshin suugaa aimag, khotoor garga
question_en: Show the number of customers with an active deposit by the province or city where they live.
gold_sql: SELECT c.province, COUNT(DISTINCT d.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.province

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сард хамгийн олон гүйлгээ хийгдсэн 3 өдөр, тухайн өдрүүдийн гүйлгээний тоог гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sard hamgiin olon gvilgee hiigdsen 3 udur, tuhain udrvvdiin gvilgeenii toog garga
question_en: Show the 3 days in June 2026 with the most transactions, along with their transaction counts.
question_mixed: 2026 оны 6-р сарын хамгийн busy 3 өдөр, тухайн өдрүүдийн transaction count-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY tx_count DESC, transaction_date LIMIT 3

question_mn: 2026 оны 2-р улирлын гүйлгээний тоог гаригаар нь (даваа=1 ... ням=7) гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 2-r ulirliin guilgeenii toog garigaar ni (davaa=1 ... nyam=7) garga
question_en: Show the number of transactions in Q2 2026 by day of the week (Monday=1 ... Sunday=7).
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM transaction_date) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд сар бүр хадгаламжийн дансанд хүү тооцож нийт хэдэн төгрөг олгосныг сараар гарга
question_latin: Ene ond sar bvr hadgalamjiin dansand hvv tootsoj niit heden tugrug olgosniig saraar garga
question_en: For each month this year, show the total amount of interest credited to savings accounts.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) AS month, SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_credited FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'INTEREST_CREDIT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Энэ оны эхний хагаст бэлэн мөнгө тушаалтын дүн нь 10 тэрбум төгрөгөөс давсан салбаруудын нэр, дүнг гарга
question_latin: Ene onii ehnii hagast belen mungu tushaaltiin dvn ni 10 terbum tugrugees dawsan salbaruudiin ner, dvng garga
question_en: Show the names and amounts of branches whose cash deposits in the first half of this year exceeded 10 billion MNT.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(t.amount_mnt) AS total_amount FROM t2s.transactions t JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = t.branch_id WHERE t.transaction_type_code = 'CASH_DEPOSIT' AND t.status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name HAVING SUM(t.amount_mnt) > 10000000000

question_mn: Жил бүр хэдэн хадгаламжийн данс нээгдсэнийг оноор нь гарга
question_latin: Jil bvr heden hadgalamjiin dans neegdseniig onoor ni garga
question_en: Show how many savings accounts were opened each year.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opened_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS opened_count FROM t2s.accounts WHERE account_type_code = 'SAVINGS' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Хадгаламжуудыг сунгагдсан тоогоор нь бүлэглээд, бүлэг тус бүрт хэдэн хадгаламж байгааг гарга
question_latin: Hadgalamjuudiig sungagdsan toogoor ni bvlegleed, bvleg tus bvrt heden hadgalamj baigaag garga
question_en: Group deposits by the number of times they have been renewed and show how many deposits are in each group.
gold_sql: SELECT renewal_count, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count FROM t2s.deposits GROUP BY renewal_count

question_mn: Анх байршуулсан дүнгээсээ хамгийн их өссөн 5 идэвхтэй төгрөгийн хадгаламжийн дугаар, өсөлтийн дүнг гарга
question_latin: Ankh bairshuulsan dungeesee khamgiin ikh osson 5 idevkhtei togrogiin khadgalamjiin dugaar, osoltiin dung garga
question_en: Show the numbers and growth amounts of the 5 active MNT deposits whose balance has grown the most above the initial principal.
gold_sql: SELECT deposit_number, current_balance - principal_amount AS growth FROM t2s.deposits WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY growth DESC, deposit_number LIMIT 5

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сард гүйлгээ хийсэн харилцагч бүр дунджаар хэдэн гүйлгээ хийсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sard gvilgee hiisen hariltsagch bvr dundjaar heden gvilgee hiisen be?
question_en: In June 2026, how many transactions on average did each transacting customer make?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(tx_count), 2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY customer_id) x

question_mn: Валют бүрийн 2026 оны 6-р сарын 30-ны ханшийг 2025 оны 12-р сарын 31-нийхтэй харьцуулж, хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга
question_latin: Valyut buriin 2026 onii 6-r sariin 30-nii khanshiig 2025 onii 12-r sariin 31-niikhtei kharitsuulj, kheden khuviar oorchlogdsoniig garga
question_en: For each currency, compare the June 30, 2026 rate with the December 31, 2025 rate and show the percentage change.
question_mixed: Currency бүрийн 2026.06.30-ны rate-ийг 2025.12.31-нийхтэй харьцуулж % change-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT a.currency_code, a.mid_rate AS rate_2025_12_31, b.mid_rate AS rate_2026_06_30, ROUND(100.0 * (b.mid_rate - a.mid_rate) / a.mid_rate, 2) AS change_pct FROM t2s.exchange_rates a JOIN t2s.exchange_rates b ON b.currency_code = a.currency_code AND b.rate_date = DATE '2026-06-30' WHERE a.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'

question_mn: 2025 оны гүйлгээний тоог улирлаар гаргаж, улирал бүр жилийн нийт гүйлгээний хэдэн хувийг эзэлснийг харуул
question_latin: 2025 onii gvilgeenii toog uliraar gargaj, uliral bvr jiliin niit gvilgeenii heden huwiig ezelsniig haruul
question_en: Show the number of transactions in each quarter of 2025 and each quarter's share of the year's total.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM transaction_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS tx_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
